data.description:
## Summary

Make the DSO validation command-resolution layer platform-independent and polyglot by removing hardcoded `make` defaults from the shared validation scripts and the sprint skill's gates. Split from the sprint-skill audit remediation (branch `claude/sprint-skill-audit-gYSHM`), which shipped the sprint-internal fixes (Phase F ordering, ruleset preflight, cascade counter) separately. This epic is the deferred "Change Set B" — the cross-cutting make-abstraction work with the broadest blast radius (touches validate.sh, validate-phase.sh, CI, debug-everything, and several skills).

This is a placeholder epic capturing fully-reviewed scope and decisions; it still needs /dso:brainstorm → /dso:preplanning → /dso:sprint decomposition before execution.

## Policy (user-confirmed)

- **Lack of config → fail loud.** A required command that is unset fails loud (dedicated exit code + `UNCONFIGURED_COMMAND: commands.<key>` on stdout). No silent skip, no soft degrade.
- **Intentional no-op → clean pass via the `none` sentinel.** `commands.<key>=none` (canonical; `skip`/`disabled` as readable aliases) means "this project deliberately has no such command" and passes cleanly. `none` is already wired for e2e (validate.sh:425) and avoids the false `e2e_ran=true` that `=true` would set.
- **Reject boolean-looking literals** (`true`/`false`/`yes`/`no`) for required commands with an instructive error steering to `none` or a real command (prevents the "=true reads like enabled" confusion).
- Scripts are **caller-agnostic** (no sprint awareness); escalation UX lives only in the sprint orchestrator on top of the scripts' exit code/sentinel. Other callers (CI, debug-everything, validate-work) get the loud failure with no escalation — intended uniform behavior.

## Decisions

- **D1: `commands.test_e2e` is REQUIRED** (unset → fail loud; escape via `none`). New hard requirement for every consumer repo (today's contract is "absent → skipped").
- **D2: Remove bug 62d3-7064's `make -n` target-existence skip** — a configured-but-missing make target fails loud like any other broken command.
- Reverses bug **5a2d-9489** (validate-phase.sh make-test-unit-only fallback) and **62d3-7064** (e2e missing-target SKIP). Rewrite their tests to assert the new fail-loud/none behavior, citing the supersession.

## Classification

- Required-when-applicable: `test_unit`, `test_e2e`, `test_visual` (visual only when UI files present, via detect-ui-files.sh).
- Optional (empty → warn-and-skip): `format`, `format_check`, `lint`, `lint_ruff`, `lint_mypy`, `syntax_check`, `test_dirs`. (`syntax_check=true`/`lint_mypy=true` optional-check builtin idiom left untouched.)

## Work items (B0-B8)

- B0: new `resolve-required-command.sh <key>` (sources only read-config.sh; caller-agnostic). run = stdout-command/exit 0; clean-SKIP (`none`/aliases) = empty-stdout/exit 0; fail (unset) = `UNCONFIGURED_COMMAND: commands.<key>` stdout + exit 3; reject boolean literals.
- B1: validate-phase.sh:92 — drop `make test-unit-only` default; resolve test_unit via B0.
- B2: validate.sh:123-136 — remove all make defaults; test_unit/test_e2e required via B0; E2E block 424-440 reuse `none` short-circuit, remove the make -n skip (D2); keep syntax/format/lint optional; preserve VALIDATE_CMD_TEST.
- B3: dedicated exit 3 + `UNCONFIGURED_COMMAND:` stdout sentinel; document in both script headers. (Confirm exit 3 is free; it is.)
- B4: sprint escalation only — relay+parse the stdout sentinel in debug-everything post-batch-validation.md/full-validation.md relay sites + sprint Step 10/Phase G/Step 12; detect-stack recommendation / supply / none / abort, memoized once-per-key interactive, non-interactive HALT; disambiguate the sentinel from the tests-pending `RUN:` stdout block.
- B5: sprint gates — Step 12 visual (SKILL.md:2043, UI-applicability-gated) and Phase G e2e (epic-ci-and-e2e-gates.md:75 AND :85) consume the resolver; drop hardcoded `cd app && make ...`; each command encodes its own dir.
- B6: Config Resolution cleanup — remove dead TEST_CMD/LINT_CMD at SKILL.md:25-26, 34-37, and the :2724 post-compaction re-resolve list+log; keep VISUAL_CMD/E2E_CMD.
- B7: set `commands.test_e2e=none` in this repo's .claude/dso-config.conf (else the repo's own `validate.sh --ci`/release.sh gate fails loud once defaults are removed).
- B8: docs+tests — fix CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md test_unit/test_e2e/test_visual entries (currently document the opposite "absent → skipped"); update dso-config.example.conf + MIGRATION-TO-PLUGIN.md (add commands.test_e2e=none guidance); rewrite test-validate-phase-missing-test-unit.sh, test-validate-e2e-missing-target.sh, replace test-validate-config-driven.sh:74-87; add a resolve-required-command.sh unit test; check validate-config.sh known-keys validator for any test_e2e optionality classification.

## Implementation-care notes (from review)

- The stdout sentinel is the PRIMARY/only orchestrator-visible signal (Step 10 haiku relays stdout, not exit codes).
- `none` short-circuit avoids false `e2e_ran=true` (validate.sh:909 sets it only when E2E_RAN=1).
- Edit config example/migration by key name, not line number (cites drift).

## Related

- Stale-YAML-config-docs bug (filed during the same audit): 1ce9-34c1-0d3a-41a3.
- Reviewed to convergence across plan v1-v9; the `none` sentinel correction superseded the earlier `=true` proposal.
data.title: Platform-independent command resolution: remove make defaults, fail-loud on unset, none-sentinel no-op
